services.name: Book A Charter
services.desc: We depart Gibsons marina and run for 5-15 minutes, depending on sea conditions and recent reports. Areas include: Camp Byng, Gower Point, Salmon Rock,Tunstill Bay and "The Hump" which is off the South side of Bowen Island. On this trip we will only be targeting Salmon as ling and rock cod are closed again this year. Rates do not include tax and gratuity. After departing Gibsons marina we run approximately 45 minutes. Our destinations are Thrasher Rock, which is just off Gabriola Island, or north of Silva Bay. We fish from Flatops to Whale Bone Bay. Sometimes the salmon are 2-3 miles off Vancouver Island. Seeing as we are crossing the Georgia Straight sea conditions are definitely something
